title: Quiver
wikitext:
A collection of hunter utilities.

== How to Install ==

# [https://github.com/SabineWren/Quiver/releases Download] latest version for releases
# Extract folder from the Zip
# Rename folder from Quiver-x.x.x to Quiver
# Move folder into TWow/Interface/AddOns/
# Restart the game

== Git Links ==
[https://github.com/SabineWren/Quiver '''(SabineWren)''']

== Commands ==
Use '''/Quiver''' or '''/qq''' to open the configuration menu.
